3 مُصَافَنَةٌ The standing confronting a people, or party. (TA.) ＝
-A2- [Also The dividing of water among a people, or party, in the manner described in the next paragraph:] one says, صَافَنَ المَآءَ بَيْنَ ↓ القَوْمِ فَأَعْطَانِى صَفْنَةً i. e. مَقْلَةً [for جُرْعَةَ مَقْلَةٍ, the meaning being He divided the water in that manner among the people, or party, and gave me a gulp as much as would cover a pebble in the bottom of a vessel]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
